mapper.select: SELECT * FROM holding WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND fund_id IN #{id} ORDER BY fund_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holding(user_id,fund_id,shares,cost_amount) VALUES (#{h.userId},#{h.fundId},#{h.shares},#{h.costAmount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE shares=VALUES(shares),cost_amount=VALUES(cost_amount),deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_order_item SET confirmed_amount=CASE id WHEN #{i.id} THEN #{i.confirmedAmount} END, confirmed_shares=CASE id WHEN #{i.id} THEN #{i.confirmedShares} END WHERE id IN #{i.id}
